subject.title: fix: prioritize exhausted Antigravity quota in menu bar and highest usage

question: Should automatic Antigravity selection use context-specific semantics—reset-focused selection for the menu bar and maximum binding usage for highest-usage ranking—or should every automatic consumer follow one exhausted-versus-usable rule?
rationale: Current code deliberately filters exhausted windows, while this PR changes which quota and potentially which provider users see; tests can verify an implementation but cannot establish the intended product contract.

options.title: Use context-specific selection
options.body: Keep reset-focused menu-bar selection separate from highest-usage ranking, while sharing cadence and family parsing so both consumers handle exhaustion consistently.

options.title: Always favor exhaustion
options.body: Make all automatic consumers select the most binding exhausted quota, accepting that existing usable-lane displays may change after upgrade.

options.title: Preserve usable fallback
options.body: Retain the current preference for usable quotas and close or narrow this PR to avoid changing established display behavior.

recommendation.title: Use context-specific selection
recommendation.body: Keep reset-focused menu-bar selection separate from highest-usage ranking, while sharing cadence and family parsing so both consumers handle exhaustion consistently.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository owner is the explicit recipient of the contributor's request for a product-contract decision.
